title: The Seminar on a Broad Claim: Testing Limits and Fixing Personal Grammar Errors · 新情境写作
instructions: 独立写至少120词。再按真实反馈订正；不要照抄源文。同一提示再次使用属于订正或巩固，不冒充未见任务。
prompt:
Write a short paragraph (120–160 words) for a student newsletter. Describe a school club that tried a new meeting time. Say what improved, what did not, and what limit you would add to the claim “The new time always works.” Use one “If + past perfect, would + verb” sentence.
Write at least 120 words. Use your own new details. Do not copy the source text.
